from datetime import datetime

candidate_song_ids = set(song_ids_from_songs) | set(album_song_ids) | set(playlist_song_ids)
print('song_lib unique', len(song_ids_from_songs))
print('album_lib unique', len(album_song_ids))
print('playlist_lib unique', len(playlist_song_ids))
print('candidate union unique songs', len(candidate_song_ids))
print('candidate ids sample', sorted(candidate_song_ids)[:20])

def parse_release_date(s):
    # try multiple formats
    for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d"]:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None

oldest = None
oldest_info = None

results = []
for sid in sorted(candidate_song_ids):
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=token, song_id=sid)
    rd = info.get('release_date')
    dt = parse_release_date(rd) if isinstance(rd, str) else None
    results.append((sid, info.get('title'), rd, dt))
    if dt is not None:
        if oldest is None or dt < oldest:
            oldest = dt
            oldest_info = info

print('fetched', len(results), 'songs')
# find min among parsed datetimes
valid = [r for r in results if r[3] is not None]
valid.sort(key=lambda x: x[3])
print('oldest parsed candidate:', valid[0] if valid else None)
print('oldest song title:', oldest_info.get('title') if oldest_info else None)
print('oldest song release_date:', oldest_info.get('release_date') if oldest_info else None)
print('oldest song id:', oldest_info.get('song_id') if oldest_info else None)
